label: For "Runbook Automation Safety Testing": Test runbooks and automation scripts in a production-like sandbox before certification, checking idempotence, blast radius and rollback so only safe automation reaches production. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Code review only.
